Ennobling problems are problems people face in their lives where they are forced to directly address one or more of the [[Nine Plagues]]. 

They generally have a structure where one part of them is rather simple and physical and another part is complex, spiritual, and defies easy addressing.

The two most obvious examples are drug addiction and being a virgin past a certain age, escaping from growing up in poverty is another example

Ennobling problems are not necessarily particularly hard to solve. They usually have simple solutions that can be implemented for most people, the hard part is overcoming the specific mental issues associated with it.
